notes.title: Winter's Empty Mask demo - 2019
notes.content:
Hello! Today I have great news to share with you, over the past year we, Eternal Night Studios, have been working on a new game called "Winter's empty mask." and we are getting close to completion. There is currently a demo out for all of you to check. This is our biggest project to date and I wholeheartedly hope you enjoy it.

notes.title: Next project on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Stw here.

As many of you have guessed, Winter’s empty mask is the next project we are working on. Currently this project has the storyline already written, but we are planning to add more routes to complement the story and increase the duration of the novel, making it more extensive than any of our previous works.

Soon we will be posting the demo’s update, including Chapter 2 along with the respective translations into Spanish, English and Russian. We will also launch the Kickstarter campaign to finance the novel, so we hope you can support us through either, direct funding of the project or through spreading the news to potential contributors.

That would be all for now, see you next week, the most important day for all members of "Eternal Night Studios"

Have a nice day.

notes.title: Important announcement.
notes.content:
Important announcement.

Hello to everyone, as you already know, we initiated two campaigns in greenlight to take visual novels "Winter's empty mask" and "Connected Hearts" to Steam. The result was excellent getting the greenlight necessary to publish on Steam. We are deeply grateful to all of you for the support provided.

There is a reason in particular which forced us to make these campaigns as soon as possible. It happens that in the Steam Forum, they announced new changes when publishing new titles, between them was to eliminate greenlight. The negative point of this new measure, is that to publish new titles, we would have to pay a fairly high price each new figure title we want publish. It was then that we decided to make the campaigns in greenlight, since this change would be made active in "Spring" (March-April - May approximately)

To date we still don't know if that change will take place or not. If that happens, we can at least publish "Connected Hearts" and "Winter's empty mask" on Steam, perhaps those are our last two projects on steam unless we raise funds to be able to pay for each other game

On our part we are working hard to bring these two titles as soon as possible, "Hearts Connected" being the first to be published.

Our goal is to continue to create more projects for your entertainment, remember that "Trick and Treat" is not our only project, we have already published projects before. The only difference is that "Trick and Treat" is so far our only project that has been released on Steam, but we hope to be able to add more projects to our catalog.

Soon we will start crowfounding campaigns too, when we are ready it will be announcing. We are looking forward for your support, meanwhile we will continue working on our various projects. 

That would be all. Have a good day, or night.
________________________________________________
Anuncio importante 

Hola a todos, como ya sabrán, iniciamos dos campañas en greenlight para llevar las novelas visuales "Winter's empty mask" y "Connected Hearts" a Steam. El resultado fue excelente, obteniendo el greenlight necesario para poder publicar en Steam. Estamos profundamente agradecidos con todos ustedes por el apoyo brindado.

Hay un motivo en particular el cual nos obligó a hacer estas campañas a la brevedad posible. Sucede que en el foro de Steam, ellos anunciaron nuevos cambios a la hora de publicar nuevos títulos, entre ellos era eliminar greenlight. El punto negativo de esta nueva medida, es que para publicar nuevos títulos, habría que pagar una cifra bastante elevada por cada nuevo titulo que queramos publicar. Fue entonces que decidimos hacer las campañas en greenlight, ya que la fecha que ellos anunciaron que se realizaría este cambio sería en "Primavera" (marzo-abril mayo aproximadamente)

Hasta la fecha aun no sabemos si ese cambio se realizará o no. Si eso ocurre, al menos podremos publicar "Connected Hearts" y "Winter's empty mask" en Steam, tal vez esos sean nuestros dos últimos proyectos en steam a menos que recaudemos fondos necesarios para poder pagar por cada publicación.

Por nuestra parte, estamos trabajando arduamente para llevarles estos dos títulos a la brevedad posible, siendo "Connected Hearts" el primero que será publicado.

Nuestra meta es seguir creando mas proyectos para el entretenimiento de ustedes, recuerden que "Trick and Treat" no es nuestro unico proyecto, ya hemos publicado proyectos antiormente. La única diferencia es que "Trick and Treat" es hasta el momento, el único proyecto que ha sido publicado en Steam pero esperamos poder añadir mas proyectos a nuestro catalogo.

notes.title: Important announcement.
notes.content:
Important announcement.

Hello to everyone, as you already know, we initiated two campaigns in greenlight to take visual novels "Winter's empty mask" and "Connected Hearts" to Steam. The result was excellent getting the greenlight necessary to publish on Steam. We are deeply grateful to all of you for the support provided.

There is a reason in particular which forced us to make these campaigns as soon as possible. It happens that in the Steam Forum, they announced new changes when publishing new titles, between them was to eliminate greenlight. The negative point of this new measure, is that to publish new titles, we would have to pay a fairly high price each new figure title we want publish. It was then that we decided to make the campaigns in greenlight, since this change would be made active in "Spring" (March-April - May approximately)

To date we still don't know if that change will take place or not. If that happens, we can at least publish "Connected Hearts" and "Winter's empty mask" on Steam, perhaps those are our last two projects on steam unless we raise funds to be able to pay for each other game

On our part we are working hard to bring these two titles as soon as possible, "Hearts Connected" being the first to be published.

Our goal is to continue to create more projects for your entertainment, remember that "Trick and Treat" is not our only project, we have already published projects before. The only difference is that "Trick and Treat" is so far our only project that has been released on Steam, but we hope to be able to add more projects to our catalog.

Soon we will start crowfounding campaigns too, when we are ready it will be announcing. We are looking forward for your support, meanwhile we will continue working on our various projects. 

That would be all. Have a good day, or night.
________________________________________________

notes.title: First month / primer mes :)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, today we celebrate our first month in steam and we are very excited that our little visual novel has been liked by most of you, I seriously give myself some time to see your comments.

But you do not think that we are a group of only one project and then disappear, we are currently working on new projects and soon we will publish a demo of our most current work. All our advances are published in our page of facebook / eternal.night.studios in addition to having more projects already published on our website.

Our request to all of you is to share and disseminate this work with others, in that way it would help us a lot. We are very grateful for all the support provided so far.

I say goodbye to all of you and have a good day or night. ːsteamhappyː

--------------------------

Hola a todos, hoy celebramos nuestro primer mes en steam y nos emociona mucho que nuestro pequeña novela visual haya sido del agrado de la mayoría de ustedes, en serio me doy algo de tiempo para ver sus comentarios.

Pero no piensen que somos un grupo de solo un proyecto para luego desaparecer, actualmente estamos trabajando en nuevos proyectos y pronto publicaremos un demo de nuestro trabajo mas actual. Todos nuestros avances lo venimos publicando en nuestra pagina de facebook/eternal.night.studios ademas de contar con mas proyectos ya publicados en nuestra pagina web.

Nuestra petición para todos ustedes es que compartan y divulguen este trabajo con los demás, de esa forma nos ayudaría mucho. Estamos muy agradecidos por todo el apoyo brindado hasta el momento.

Me despido de todos ustedes y que tenga un buen día o noche. ːsteamhappyː
